# HR Welfare Policy Review and Updates

This document details the ongoing requirements for reviewing and updating key human resources welfare policies:

*   Review career development based on audit findings.
*   Update the bonus structure quarterly.
*   Monitor career development standard updates.
*   Review annual leave policies quarterly.
*   Investigate medical insurance standard updates.
